finding: The unblocked factorization creates an OpenMP parallel reduction for every lower-triangular element: n*(n+1)/2, or 1,181,953 separate regions at n=1537, plus row-zeroing regions. This is a plausible source of excessive synchronization overhead at 128 threads, not a demonstrated arithmetic error.
observed_failure: The exclusive larger-shape execution produces no flushed stdout and exceeds the unchanged 30-second correctness timeout. It previously passed the n=513 case; the previously published performance benchmark had already failed.
interpretation: Retain the approved supplemental validation timeout as failed external validation. Do not describe this as a proven numerical defect or concurrency failure. The exact phase at timeout was not traced, and no retry or timeout relaxation was performed.
investigation: Static source inspection and retained exclusive validation result; no new program execution.
